what: Tenaris makes steel pipes for the oil and gas industry: the casing and tubing that line wells, and line pipe for pipelines. It manufactures in many countries and is controlled by the Rocca family through the Techint group.
customers: Oil and gas producers and drilling contractors worldwide, particularly in the Americas and the Middle East.
money: seamless and welded steel pipe for wells and pipelines
sucker rods, industrial equipment and services
moat: Mills close to the major oil basins combined with technical service at the wellsite, so customers buy a solution rather than a commodity pipe.
risks: Drilling activity drives demand and has been flat to down
Steel and scrap input costs are volatile
Family control limits minority shareholder influence
opportunities: Operating margin of 19% with cash of $3 billion against almost no debt
Middle Eastern drilling activity has stayed strong
A dividend yield around 3% with buybacks on top
watch: Rig counts in the Americas and the Middle East, and pipe pricing.
